fonts.display: 'Noto Serif', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif
fonts.body: 'Manrope', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Midnight Ink
palette.role: Primary text, primary CTA fill, strong borders — the dominant brand dark; a slightly blue-tinted near-black that reads warmer than pure black on white

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills

palette.name: Ash Border
palette.role: Default hairline borders, button outlines, icon strokes

palette.name: Carbon Nav
palette.role: Navigation text and thin nav borders — sits one step lighter than Midnight Ink

palette.name: Mist Blue
palette.role: Cool-tinted card borders and subtle section dividers

palette.name: Pure Black
palette.role: SVG fills, icon glyphs, and high-contrast decorative shapes only — not used for UI text or backgrounds

palette.name: Prism Pink
palette.role: Accent stroke and badge accent — warm half of the prism spectrum

palette.name: Prism Green
palette.role: Accent stroke and success state highlight

palette.name: Cream Wash
palette.role: Soft tinted surface for cards and badges tied to the yellow accent

palette.name: Mint Wash
palette.role: Soft tinted surface for cards and badges tied to the green accent

palette.name: Blush Wash
palette.role: Soft tinted surface for cards and badges tied to the pink accent

palette.name: Sky Wash
palette.role: Soft tinted surface tied to the blue accent — appears in gradient fills and decorative washes
